title: We’re hiring a video editor for an English-language entertainment YouTube channel!
description:
We’re hiring a video editor for an English-language entertainment YouTube channel!
Our channel features a virtual host who watches and comments on Roblox video compilations. We’re looking for an editor who understands English, has a good sense of humor, and knows when a meme or sound effect will make a moment funnier.
We already have one editor and an established editing style. We’re looking for a second person who can watch our finished videos, pick up the pacing, and edit in the same style.
What we’re looking for:
— You’re confident editing long-form, horizontal videos. Experience with entertainment content on YouTube is a big plus.
— You understand conversational English well and are familiar with English-language memes.
— You have a good sense of pacing, taste, and restraint. We don’t want every scene overloaded with effects.
— You’re proficient in professional editing software. If you only edit in CapCut, please don’t apply.
— You have a computer that can comfortably handle long videos and export in 1080p and 4K.
Finished videos are approximately 15-30 minutes long.
Turnaround: up to two days per video.
Workload: 15 videos per month.
Pay: $700 per month.
Selection is based on a short editing test: you’ll edit the first 2-3 minutes of a video using our materials and a reference. A portfolio is optional-we’re more interested in seeing how well you capture our style.
To receive the test brief, contact Alexey on Telegram: @mr_kudinov
